summary: The current implementation conforms to the saved Issue #307 plan: past-settle remonitor persists the operator hint, re-arms existing grace/settle freeze state, carries OPERATOR_REMONITOR context into events and monitor actions, returns the REMONITOR_PAST_SETTLE warning, blocks auto-merge in the pure monitor decision until the hint is processed, dispatches the operator-hint repair prompt, updates response-warning schema/OpenAPI and REST/MCP contract fixtures, and records focused validation evidence. Broad AWF/GitHub validation remains owned by the post-agent validation phase.
